support_checks.label_check: ADP has no failure labels: the loader emits no label. The only success-like std values are swe-gym details.resolved ('True' in every row, as is the parsed test_result report.resolved) and openhands details.feedback ('positive' in every row); nebius details.exit_status holds three submission outcomes. They are echoed in outcome.raw, only resolved sets outcome.success, and no value maps to a failure.
